correctness.rationale: Cut parity forces both horizontal edges at a cut together; this gives a bijection with monomer/dimer column tilings. Disjoint horizontal pairs shatter floor(n/2) queries. For an arbitrary shattered support, the all-ones matching fixes h disjoint dimers and v disjoint rungs; two complementary parity assignments match v selected rung columns injectively to distinct unqueried columns, forcing 2v<=n-2h. The exact Ldim at n=11 is sandwiched between a fully checked 127-query, 128-leaf depth-seven witness against 144 actual graph matchings and the counting upper bound floor(log2 144)=7. Repeating the depth-seven tree on independent 11-column blocks within ordinary ladders yields Ldim>=7m. Explicit scripts verified against the embedded actual witness; no general-width online equality is inferred.

value.rationale: The all-order exact VC formula is a natural invariant for full perfect-matching classes on grid ladders. A complete finite 11-column adaptive witness proves two-round excess and yields a gap growing at least ceil(3m/2) on ordinary two-vertex-connected planar bipartite subcubic graphs, each edge being matching-feasible. This removes the structurally degenerate forbidden-bridge mechanism of known connected examples; no unsupported exact online formula for other widths is claimed.
